test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Recently, Hindi Diwas was celebrated on September 14, 2025, marking the adoption of Hindi as India’s official language in 1949. Under which Article of the Indian Constitution has the language Hindi been conferred the status of official language?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 343.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India observed Hindi Diwas on September 14, 2025, commemorating the adoption of Hindi as the official language of the Indian Union on September 14, 1949, under Article 343__ of the Constitution.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 343__ of the Constitution declares __Hindi in Devanagari script__ as the official language of the Indian Union.**
 
• This decision was taken by the __Constituent Assembly on 14 September 1949__.
 
• Hindi Diwas is celebrated __every year on 14 September__ to promote the use of Hindi across the nation.
 
• The 2025 theme was "__Hindi: Strength of National Integration and Global Identity__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Article 343__

 __
 
• Specifies Hindi in Devanagari script as the official language of the Union.
 
• Allows the use of English for official purposes for 15 years from the commencement of the Constitution (later extended).
 
 
 
• Article 351__
 __
 
• Directive for the development and promotion of Hindi language.
 
• Encourages enrichment of Hindi by assimilating forms from other Indian languages.
 
 
 
• Article 348__
 __
 
• Specifies the language (English) to be used in the Supreme Court and High Courts.
 
 
 
• Article 356__
 
 
• Deals with the imposition of President’s Rule in states on failure of constitutional machinery.
